recorded.finalText:
The support-chat pipeline is built and working: a chat source feeds questions into an Anthropic LLM node configured for claude-sonnet-4-6 (using your `${ROCKETRIDE_ANTHROPIC_KEY}` variable), and its answers flow back to the chat response node.

I validated the pipeline (no errors) and ran a live test: sent "Hello, can you confirm you are Claude Sonnet 4.6?" and the run completed the question through the LLM and back to the chat response with completedCount 1/1 and no errors — just one unrelated benign warning about an unused `raw` lane. I then terminated the test task since chat sources stay open waiting for more input.

The pipeline is ready for you to use — nothing left to do unless you'd like it deployed to a team or scheduled.
